mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resume_file (profile_id, original_filename, file_type, file_size, storage_path, uploaded_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{profileId}, #{originalFilename}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{storagePath}, #{uploadedAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE resume_file SET original_filename=#{originalFilename}, file_type=#{fileType}, file_size=#{fileSize}, storage_path=#{storagePath}, uploaded_at=#{uploadedAt}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE profile_id=#{profileId}
